scope: read-only adapter and preparation script, not full model qualification
core_argument: For a single valid query, deleting whole assertions strengthens the proof obligation: UNSAT of the reduced conjunction implies UNSAT of the original. Remaining terms are not rewritten.

findings.issue: Unrecognized top-level commands are not actually rejected despite docstring; echo/output-producing commands pass through, while solver stdout is forwarded unchanged.
findings.evidence: reduce_task has only a blacklist, no whitelist. Why3 call_provers.ml analyse_result gives Answer Valid priority (line261), even among multiple answers. Thus actual result must be isolated from arbitrary output; generated fixed Why3 input narrows exposure but does not implement claimed general fail-closed guarantee.
findings.recommendation: New version whitelist actual generated commands and strictly validate solver exit/output. Preserve v14.

findings.issue: Evidence filenames depend only on original SMT hash; parallel invocations with different CLI/timeouts can overwrite stdout/stderr and metadata.
findings.recommendation: Unique per-invocation directory, include argv, solver SHA, exit code and output hashes.

other_limits: Substring detection may remove more assertions than semantically necessary, but this only strengthens the task.
Unsupported occurrence in retained goal/definition rejects conservatively.
No SMT solver run was performed by reviewer.
Source/input/output hashes do not by themselves qualify a new FP/BV model.
